title: GDPR & Privacy Setup
description: Cookie consent, privacy policy, and data-processing basics for EU/UK-facing WordPress sites.

steps.title: Publish Privacy Policy
steps.instructions: Create or import a privacy policy covering data collected, legal basis, retention, processors, and contact details for requests.

steps.title: Install Cookie Consent Banner
steps.instructions: Add a GDPR-compliant cookie banner that blocks non-essential scripts until consent. Map categories to analytics and marketing tags.

steps.title: Document Data Processors
steps.instructions: List third-party processors (host, email, analytics, CRM, chat) and link their privacy policies in the privacy page.

steps.title: Add Form Consent Fields
steps.instructions: Ensure contact and newsletter forms include explicit consent checkboxes where required. Log consent timestamp if storing leads.

steps.title: Test Data Export & Erasure
steps.instructions: Use Tools → Export Personal Data and Erase Personal Data to verify the site can fulfill subject access requests.

steps.title: Review Gravatar & External Embeds
steps.instructions: Disable Gravatars or lazy-load embeds that leak visitor IPs to third parties if strict privacy mode is required.
